follow-up time: Duration of hospital stay after delivery
exposure: Mode of delivery (cesarean section vs. vaginal delivery)
outcome: Length of hospital stay after delivery
cohort: 939,678 births among 551,119 women in Denmark between 1997 and 2014.
finding: Women with CHD had a significantly longer hospital stay after delivery compared to women without CHD, with increasing severity of CHD associated with longer lengths of stay, and this association was not modified by mode of delivery.
mod_finding: While women who had a cesarean section had a longer average hospital stay compared to those who had a vaginal delivery, mode of delivery did not modify the association between maternal CHD and length of hospital stay.
